name: Scene sockets: openings that snap scenes together
body: A `scene_socket` entity inside a scene marks an opening: its position, its facing (the entity's yaw) and a width and height. Stitching places an instance so one of its sockets coincides with a socket of the neighbour, facing the opposite way. The loader records each pair of joined sockets as an adjacency, which the peek rendering and the partner's graph use. Snapping is data and pure maths first, tested without an editor.
